test.title: A place where you would like to live in the future

document.cue: Describe a place where you would like to live in the future.

text: In the future I'd love to live in a small house on the edge of Almaty, somewhere in the foothills, with a view of the mountains. My plan is to move there in about ten years, once I've saved enough and my career is more settled.

I'm not dreaming of anything huge. I'd like a two-storey house with a big kitchen, because I love cooking for friends, and a small room I could use as an office. Most importantly, I want a garden where I can grow apple trees — Almaty was once famous for its apples, and my grandfather had a whole orchard.

I've actually started preparing in small ways. Last spring I visited a few neighbourhoods on the edge of the city with my partner to see what they're like, and I've been looking at how people build energy-efficient houses, with solar panels and good insulation, because winters there can be quite cold.

The main reason is that I've lived in apartment blocks all my life, and I'd like more space and quiet. At the same time, I don't want to be too far from the city, because my work and friends are there. The foothills are a good compromise: fresh air, but only about thirty minutes from the centre.
It's a long-term plan, but thinking about it keeps me motivated.

tips.en: Almaty was once famous for its apples adds personal and local history.
